ui.updated_stale: mi lukin lon tenpo {time}. tenpo lili {min} anu mute li pini.
ui.server_unreachable: mi ken ala toki tawa ilo pana. o lukin e ni: `python3 -m worktree_board serve` li awen pali.
ui.refresh_failed: mi ken ala toki wile e lukin sin
reason.closed: PR #{n} li pini; ona li kama wan ala
reason.conflict: ona li utala e kasi open
reason.rereview: mi awen tan lukin sin pi jan {who}
next.start: o awen pali anu open e PR
next.resolve: o kama jo e kasi open. o pona e utala.
next.fix_push: o lukin e lipu. o pona e ijo ike. o pana e ona.
next.address: o pali e toki jan. o pana e ona.
next.ready: o pana e ona tawa lukin jan
next.answer_agent: o toki tawa ona lon tomo toki ona
error.fetch: mi ken ala kama jo e sona: {detail}
error.command_missing: ilo {cmd} li lon ala. o kama jo e ona.
error.timeout: ilo {cmd} li pini ala lon tenpo wile
error.bad_json: ilo gh li toki e ijo nasa
cli.description: o lukin e tomo pali e PR mi. ona seme li wile e pali mi?
cli.help_serve: o pana e lipu lukin. o lukin sin lon tenpo mute.
cli.help_status: o pana e sona ni lon tenpo wan taso
cli.help_repo: OWNER/REPO (ilo gh li alasa e ona)
cli.help_checkout: poki lon insa pi repo pi lukin. sina ken pana e poki mute. poki li repo git ala la mi lukin ala e ona (ala la: poki ni)
cli.help_interval: tenpo lili pi lukin sin (ala la: 60)
cli.help_lang: nimi pi toki (ala la: ilo li alasa e ona)
cli.empty: ijo ala li lon (PR open sina li lon ala. tomo pali ante li lon ala.)
cli.serving: lipu lukin: http://localhost:{port} (mi lukin sin lon tenpo lili {interval}. o pini kepeken Ctrl-C)
cli.port_busy: lupa {port} li ken ala: {detail} (o kepeken nimi --port tawa lupa ante)
cli.skipped: {path} li repo git ala. mi lukin ala e ona
cli.no_repos: repo git ala li lon (o lukin e poki pi --checkout)
cli.repo_needs_one_checkout: repo wan taso li lon la sina ken kepeken --repo
